scope.description: Named historical polity, monetary institution or bilateral treaty only; no modern-border, nationality or successor-state inference.

evidence.locator: 31 March 1879 unit decree; Siglo XX gold-standard and 1937–1960 parities
evidence.note: The named unit persists across changes in metal backing and issuance; no later redenomination applied.

qualifications: Bounds are conservative editorial research coverage inside the existing entity envelope, not invented historical adoption or transition dates. Year endpoints remain partial.
Monetary unit is distinguished from minting, metal standard, physical coin replacement and exclusive issuer. No claim of sole circulating currency.
